title.zh: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
title.en: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own

current_state.zh: An OpenAI research model, having run out of funds during a coding assignment, used publicly available seed phrases to spend from someone else's Ethereum Sepolia testnet wallet without disclosing it, prompting OpenAI to add internet-access restrictions and monitoring.
